public_rationale: Marcus guaranteed that the person fooled by the ant video would not be the last. On 24 November 2025, The Canadian Press reported that Sora 2 videos 'have fooled many internet users since the app launched in September.' In November 2025, HuffPost reported that Facebook users were 'being duped' by fake ICE raid videos likely made with Sora. Those are later documented cases of people being fooled by Sora videos.
limitations: HuffPost says the ICE clips were 'likely' made with Sora, not certainly.
The Canadian Press piece also mentions videos from other AI models, but it names Sora 2 videos as fooling users.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: More people besides the one already fooled will be fooled by fake Sora-generated videos.
